issue.title: Bug: setup-management-network waits for user to restart impacted services

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

The `setup-network-management.sh` script installs `bridge-utils` which requires the networkd-dispatcher service to be restarted. It waits for the user input with TUI to approve / deny the service to be restarted.

This should be done automatically instead of waiting for the user input.

### Steps to Reproduce

Setup the test environment in a new VM which doesnt have `bridge-utils` installed by default and see that the script waits for the input from the user.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The script should complete without user intervention.

### Relevant log output

```shell
┌────┤ Daemons using outdated libraries ├─────┐
                │                                             │
                │                                             │
                │ Which services should be restarted?         │
                │                                             │
                │    [ ] Service restarts being deferred:     │
 systemctl restart networkd-dispatcher.service                │
 systemctl restart walinuxagent.service                       │
                │                                             │
No containers need to be restarted.          <Cancel>         │
                │                                             │
No user sessions are running outdated binaries.───────────────┘
```

resolution.title: Make apt-get install non-interactive in setup-management-network
resolution.description:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/19098

### Description of PR

The script to setup the management network should automatically the restart the necessary services when installing the packages.

Summary:
Fixes # [19098](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/19098)

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)

### Approach
What is the motivation for this PR?
In a virtual testbed, when setting up management-network, the script attempts to install the bridge-utils, which requires some services to be restart and since the install is invoked by a script, the TUI waits for an input and doesnt proceed.

How did you do it?
Use noninteractive mode and also set NEEDRESTART_MODE to automatically restart services when required.

How did you verify/test it?
Verified the management setup is successful
